If the request rules days out, list those days in excluded_days. If it names the only days that work, list those days in days.
Wishes such as "ideally" or "if possible" are not firm rules. To follow one, first call find_slots with the wish included. If that finds nothing, call it again without the wish.
Then call book with one of the slots that find_slots returned. If find_slots finds no slot for the firm rules, call give_up.
